settings.question: What is HORO?
settings.answer: HORO is a wearable art brand based in Egypt. We create designs around feelings, moods, moments, and gifts — turning emotional territory into clothing you can wear and share.

settings.question: How do I choose my size?
settings.answer: Each product page includes a size guide with measurements in centimeters. Compare the measurements to a shirt you already own. If you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up.

settings.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
settings.answer: Yes. Cash on Delivery is available at checkout for most areas in Egypt. You will see the option during checkout if your address is eligible.

settings.question: Can I exchange a product?
settings.answer: We accept exchanges within 14 days of delivery, provided the item is unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging. See our exchange policy page for full details.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery time depends on your location. Most orders within Cairo and Giza arrive within 1–2 business days. Other governorates typically take 2–5 business days. You will receive tracking information once your order ships.

settings.question: How does gift wrapping work?
settings.answer: You can add gift wrapping to eligible products from the product page. The gift wrap option appears near the add-to-cart button. Gift wrap is added as a separate item in your cart and can be removed at any time.
